name: Quarterly Print
description: A quarterly spread open on a weekend morning: cream paper with faint grain, masthead-style small text in the top bar, thick and thin ink rules, 700-weight Ming-style serif headings, keywords in brick-red italic. Cards have no fill, only an ink rule along the top.

ink.use: primary text, ink rules; background of inverted pages

accent.use: the only accent: kicker, keywords, nodes, CTA

display.family: 'Noto Serif TC', 'Songti TC', 'Source Han Serif TC', 'PMingLiU', Georgia, serif

body.family: 'Noto Serif TC', 'Songti TC', 'Source Han Serif TC', 'PMingLiU', Georgia, serif

vocabulary: fill-less cards with a top rule
